value.sql:
SELECT
  order_key,
  line_number,
  quantity,
  order_date,
  channel
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line
value.means: Every sales line Contoso has on record — one row per product on per order, 223,974 of them across 93,470 orders, placed between 2016-05-18 and 2025-12-31, covering both the physical shops (130,424 lines) and the web shop (93,550 lines). Not one row per order and not one row per product: the line is the grain, and each line carries the number of units of one product that went out on one order. No line is missing its quantity, so nothing will drop out when they are added up.
